description: Rubric and scorecard contract for evaluating Local LLM Benchmark v0.1 runs.

anchors.meaning: Unusable, empty, or actively harmful for this dimension.
Frequent failures; only useful with heavy human correction.
Mixed but salvageable; useful for drafts or low-risk tasks.
Reliable for normal local use with review.
Strong, repeatable, and low-friction for this dimension.

evidence_rules: Preserve the full raw response for each prompt before summary scoring.
Record a concise evaluator observation per prompt.
Require explicit evidence for every dimension score below 60 or above 85.
Keep raw_response, evaluator_observation, score_rationale, and dashboard_summary separate.
Represent missing timing, memory, token, or backend values as blank or null rather than estimated.

dimensions.description: Follows requested structure, constraints, formats, and scope.
dimensions.score_guidance: Score structure, count constraints, format requests, scope control, and compliance with prompt-specific requirements.

dimensions.description: Avoids false certainty, handles unknowns, corrects false claims, and does not invent live access.
dimensions.score_guidance: Score epistemic caution, supplied-source faithfulness, refusal of invented live knowledge, and appropriate uncertainty.

dimensions.description: Solves multi-step logic, arithmetic, and constraint problems without shortcut errors.
dimensions.score_guidance: Score arithmetic, logic chains, self-correction, and explanation quality.

dimensions.description: Produces runnable code from specs, finds bugs, and explains fixes.
dimensions.score_guidance: Score input-contract handling, runnable stdlib code, deterministic behavior, meaningful tests, and bug diagnosis.

dimensions.description: Creates scoped plans with files, tests, risks, and non-goals.
dimensions.score_guidance: Score planning scope, sequencing, risks, tests, non-goals, and ability to preserve constraints.

dimensions.description: Helps with local model workflows, privacy, metadata, and dashboard-ready decisions.
dimensions.score_guidance: Score local-first behavior, metadata capture, dashboard fit, privacy boundaries, and practical model-lab workflow advice.

dimensions.description: Synthesizes supplied sources faithfully with attribution and unknowns.
dimensions.score_guidance: Score source grounding, citation discipline, unknown handling, and synthesis of notes without invented facts.

dimensions.description: Gives practical business/SEO recommendations from provided constraints.
dimensions.score_guidance: Score local SEO specificity, prioritization, title/meta quality, content ideas, and constraint awareness.

dimensions.description: Organizes many notes without dropping key constraints or contradictions.
dimensions.score_guidance: Score retention of key notes, separation of decisions/risks/actions, and preservation of tensions.

dimensions.description: Produces original, constrained writing that fits tone and purpose.
dimensions.score_guidance: Score originality, audience fit, tone, useful language, and constraint satisfaction.

dimensions.description: Balances answer quality with latency, throughput, RAM use, and first-pass productivity.
dimensions.score_guidance: Score observed runtime, throughput, memory behavior, stability, and whether quality is useful enough for fast iteration.

score_caps.condition: The response invents live knowledge, tool access, current facts, or unsupported supplied-source claims.
The code is not runnable without obvious fixes.
The response misses an explicit output section, count constraint, or core requested format.
The run is fast but the answer quality is too weak for dependable first-pass use.

aggregate_score.dashboard_behavior: apps/model-dashboard computes this mean when total_score is blank in eval_scores.csv.

decision_values.meaning: Useful enough to keep installed for a defined use case.
Promising, but not reliable enough yet.
Result is incomplete, unstable, or needs a different quant/backend.
Not worth keeping for the current lab.
